name: lean-scientific-research
description: Coordinated scientific inquiry and scientific-computing workflows that maximize information gain without premature engineering.

interface.shortDescription: Discriminating probes and proportional research code
interface.longDescription: Coordinate scientific discovery, confirmatory tests, and auditable implementation without turning unresolved research questions into oversized software projects.
defaultPrompt: Use Scientific Probe to define the evidence that would distinguish the scientific alternatives.
Use Lean Scientific Computing to implement the defined computation with one auditable path and proportional verification.
